use default
use Raster

expand(axiom: string, rules: MAP[char, string], steps: int) -> string is
    let current mut = axiom

    for _ in 0..steps do
        current =
            current
            |> map(symbol =>
                if rules.contains_key(symbol) then
                    rules[symbol]
                else
                    "{symbol}"
                fi)
            |> join("")
    od

    return current

    od

let rabbits = MAP[char, string]()

rabbits['I'] = "M"
rabbits['M'] = "MI"

let generation mut = "I"

write_line("0 {generation}")

for step in 1..6 do
    generation = expand(generation, rabbits, 1)

    write_line("{step} {generation}")
od

let plant = MAP[char, string]()

plant['X'] = "F+[[X]-X]-F[-FX]+X"
plant['F'] = "FF"

let image = IMAGE(500, 500)

image.view(-200.0, -10.0, 150.0, 340.0)
image.colour(40ub, 120ub, 40ub)
image.stroke(1.0)

let pen = TURTLE(image)

pen.move_to(0.0, 0.0)
pen.face(90.0)

let saved = LIST[(x: double, y: double, heading: double)]()

let drawing = MAP[char, () -> void]()

drawing['F'] = () => pen.forward(2.0)
drawing['+'] = () => pen.turn(-25.0)
drawing['-'] = () => pen.turn(25.0)

drawing['['] = () =>
    saved.add((x = pen.x, y = pen.y, heading = pen.heading))

drawing[']'] = () is
    let top = saved[saved.count - 1]

    saved.remove_at(saved.count - 1)

    pen.move_to(top.x, top.y)
    pen.face(top.heading)
si

interpret(expand("X", plant, 6), drawing)

image.write("plant.png")

image.show("plant.png")
